title: Run Context
description: Authoritative per-run state shared by the orchestrator and every sub-agent. Written once by the orchestrator at the end of Phase 2 to workloads/{name}/run/context.json, then read-only. human_answers holds the Phase 1 gate answers verbatim and outranks anything a sub-agent receives in its prompt.

run_id.description: Correlates context.json, decisions.jsonl and trace_events.jsonl for this run

started_at.description: Run start. Generated artifacts use this, never datetime.now()

current_phase.description: Furthest phase or step the orchestrator has entered, e.g. "4.3". Read by the SessionStart hook to restore place after a compaction; a value of 5 or above (or "complete") means the run is no longer in flight.

scope.description: Optional policy scope used to resolve organization, domain, and project zone contracts.

effective_contract.description: Resolved contract evidence captured by the orchestrator. Missing for legacy runs during gradual migration.

timestamp_mode.description: Only 'fixed' is valid — wall-clock timestamps break determinism

human_answers.description: Phase 1 gate answers, recorded verbatim as the human stated them. Authoritative: a sub-agent MUST prefer these over any value interpolated into its prompt.

primary_key.description: Columns the human named as the PK — never inferred

dedup_strategy.description: Verbatim. Read by both Transformation (4.3) and Quality (4.4), which may run in parallel.

null_handling.description: Verbatim. Read by both Transformation (4.3) and Quality (4.4), which may run in parallel.

transformations.description: Derived columns, calculations, custom logic. Empty string only if the human explicitly said none.

pii_columns.description: Confirmed by the human, not inferred from column names

quality_thresholds.description: Per-zone or per-dimension thresholds as stated by the human

schedule.description: Cron expression or preset, explicitly stated by the human

schedule_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the schedule, stated by the human. dag_spec.schedule.timezone is required, so without this the DAG agent would have to invent one — ask instead.

iac_target_frameworks.description: IaC output formats explicitly selected by the human before any iac-agent starts.

iac_target_framework.description: Backward-compatible single-format answer. New workflows should record iac_target_frameworks.

deployment_target_products.description: Data products and platform services explicitly confirmed by the human from the requirements-auditor inventory.

iac_tbac_principals.description: Lake Formation tag-based grants, named by the human. Never defaulted, and never silently set to the current IAM caller — an empty list is a blocking issue, not permission to guess.

iac_query_principal_arn.description: IAM role ARN explicitly named by the human for Athena/query verification. Never defaulted to the current caller.

notes.description: Anything else the human said that a downstream agent should not lose

contract_overrides.description: Optional per-run changes. They may only tighten the effective inherited contract.

previous_phases.description: Append-only record of completed phases. A sub-agent validates these checksums before trusting upstream artifacts.

short_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest, truncated to 16 chars by compute_input_hash() or full 64
